description: This file defines the LoanDelinquencyData class which serves as a data container for loan delinquency information within the Fineract loan portfolio module. It includes references to collection data related to loans and their installments.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyData
classes.description: A data class holding information about loan delinquency, including loan collection data and a map of installment collection data.

methods.name: LoanDelinquencyData (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a LoanDelinquencyData instance with specified loan collection data and installment collection data.
